01.title: AED 2,000,000 unit, AED 1,000,000 paid: the most a developer may keep on termination
01.source: Our calculation from the ceilings in Dubai Law No. 19 of 2017, Article 11. Figures in AED thousands
01.alt: Stacked bars for an AED 2,000,000 unit with AED 1,000,000 paid: the developer may keep up to AED 800,000 above 60 per cent completion, AED 500,000 below 60 per cent, and AED 300,000 if work never started
